visual_rationale: A clean, single-column UML class diagram that shows only the containment/ownership hierarchy (Account → AddressBook → Contact & ContactGroup) and the single recursive parent link on ContactGroup, hiding all bidirectional navigability to avoid visual clutter.

primary_flow_strategy.description: Classes are stacked top-to-bottom in order of ownership: Account at the top, AddressBook below it, and Contact plus ContactGroup at the bottom as contents.

edge_pruning_strategy.description: Draw only the owning-side associations (Account-AddressBook, AddressBook-Contact, AddressBook-ContactGroup, ContactGroup-parent); omit the inverse navigability arrows to keep the diagram sparse.

structuring_design_principle.grouping_logic: No extra containers; the vertical stack itself acts as an implicit ownership lane.
